name: PostReady — YouTube to X
description: Turn a YouTube link into a verified MP4 for X, with the PostReady local companion.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self'; object-src 'self'; connect-src http://127.0.0.1:3002; img-src 'self' https://i.ytimg.com data:; media-src 'self' http://127.0.0.1:3002; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self'
